postRunInterpretation.explanation: The first native invocation returned inference_unavailable; the runner stopped without retry or fallback. A separate native auth-status query, using the same environment outside the sandbox, reported signed out. There is no completed model extraction to grade. The init model label is a CLI report, not evidence that the provider executed that model. Native usage and reported cost were absent; actual billing was not measured.
postRunInterpretation.scoringCorrection: This original runner still tested recall against the empty database after extraction failed. Its record, scope, rationale and recall booleans are not model-quality evidence. The current runner marks those checks inconclusive (null), skips recall probes, and marks semantic review not_reviewable on incomplete extraction. The original observations above are preserved.
postRunInterpretation.subsequentChanges: The unchanged six-case fixture remains frozen. Prompt v2 shares a context vocabulary with recall, and the CLI now accepts --conditions. No native v2 extraction has been run.
